reviews.title: AVOID APP
reviews.text:
Avoid this app. None of the advertised features actually work. The scanner can’t focus on or recognize QR codes, even when they’re large, clear, and well-lit. Importing QR codes from photos doesn’t work either.

To make matters worse, the app appears to make canceling your subscription unnecessarily difficult. The “Change Plan” screen works perfectly, but when you tap “Cancel Subscription,” it just takes you back to the same Change Plan page with no way to actually cancel. It feels like you’re forced to subscribe without being given a functional way to stop the subscription.

Save yourself the frustration and choose a different QR code app.
